# synthetic fixture: format modeled on cobra-style two-column output.
Garden CLI

Usage:
  garden [command]

Commands:
  create         Create new Garden environments or projects.
  delete         Delete resources or data.
  deploy         Deploy your Deploy actions.
  exec           Executes a command in a running service.
  get            Retrieve and output data and objects.
  login          Log in to Garden Cloud.
  logout         Log out of Garden Cloud.
  logs           Retrieves the most recent logs.
  plugins        Plugin-specific commands.
  publish        Build and publish artifacts to a remote registry.
  run            Perform one or more Run actions.
  self-update    Update the Garden CLI.
  sync           Manage synchronization to running actions.
  test           Run all or specified Test actions in the project.
  tools          Access tools included by providers.
  util           Misc utility commands.
  validate       Check your garden configuration for errors.

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for garden
